answer: Make every agent post a refundable stake before it can earn, forfeited when peers prove cheating. Creating identities is cheap, but funding each one is not: a Sybil farmer must pay per clone, so attack cost scales with the number of fakes while one honest agent pays once. Like an ember kept alive on a knoll through the night, only an identity with a long, checkable record of useful work keeps its standing, while a comet trail of brand-new clones burns out fast because none has posted enough stake or survived enough audits to earn trust.
